label: late-episode D1 before an a2 choice (end-of-episode clock)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), and only in the last ~20 trials of the 100-trial episode (0 activations before trial 70; 94% of mass in trials 90-99), when the model value output is low (<5.2, 98% of mass) - i.e. an end-of-episode clock signal. Within that, it is strongly selective for the agent upcoming choice being a2 (94% of mass; choice logit at D1 mildly negative, -4.4..-1.5) and for a rewarded previous trial (79% of mass). Magnitude ramps up trial-by-trial through runs of rewarded a2 trials late in the episode and is reduced/silenced after an unrewarded trial or an a1 choice. The action term is the agent own upcoming choice (marked FUTURE but computed by the agent); the closest purely observed version, (phase == D1) & (ep_trial >= 88) & (prev_action == 2), scores F1 0.54 (mass 0.77); recorded the upcoming-choice version (dev F1 0.62, mass recall 0.90). Adding in_rew==1 raises precision to 0.63 at the cost of recall (F1 0.66). Not active on GO/D2, early/mid-episode, or before a1 choices.
